snippet.title: WASTE THE FALLEN | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
THE DEEPER YOU GO
THE LESS HUMAN YOU RETURN

WASTE THE FALLEN is a cosmic-horror extraction shooter where every descent could be your last.

Enter The Deep, scavenge valuable gear, survive the horrors lurking within, and escape before the darkness consumes you.

Go in alone or form a squad of up to three—but stay alert. Other Deviants are hunting for the same loot, and something far worse is waiting in the dark.

The Alpha Test begins in North America on September 4, 2026.

The deeper you descend, the closer you come to the truth.

Follow the clues and uncover what lies beneath.

Brave enough to face the Deep?
Wishlist Now: 🔗 https://bit.ly/3Sun1iU
Follow the Community:🔗http://discord.gg/wastethefallen
Official Website:🔗 https://wastethefallen.com?from=youtube
